connectionId.description: A key-manager connection's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

mount.description: The provider location: an OpenBao KV mount, a Bitwarden project id or name, or a Doppler project. Absent to list OpenBao mounts or Bitwarden projects, or use Doppler's token scope.

path.description: The path under an OpenBao mount, or a Doppler config name; absent for the mount's top or the token's scope. Bitwarden lists keys in the selected project.
